cases.name: Catherin Rosmery Alonzo López
cases.about:
She was a native of Guatemala. “We are very hurt…there are no words. “Many memories come to mind...I don't know what to say,” said the woman's father through tears. The man asked not to be identified during an interview with Univision 62.

Friends of Catherine Alonzo López indicated that she came to the United States to achieve the American dream and they never imagined that it would end in tragedy.
cases.narrative: On 5/17/2022, police discovered her buried in their backyard. On 5/16/2022, police found her partner, Josue Saravia-Agueta, with injuries to his neck and was unable to speak outside the garage of the house they shared. He was taken to a hospital. On 5/17/2022, according to unofficial sources, relatives visited the house to feed the animals and noticed a “disturbed ground” in the backyard. They called the sheriff’s office which executed a search warrant. BCSO deputies discovered Alonzo-Lopez’s body.

cases.name: Randi Lynn Mitchell
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Randi was a CNA and a Dog Groomer. Her greatest joy was working and spending time with animals of all kinds. Her love for animals was genuine."

"She was very loving. She loved animals. She cared for everybody. If she met somebody that she knew was struggling in their life," said Mitchell’s mother (who didn’t want to be identified because of safety concerns). "She kind of clung to those people, and she tried to bring out the best in them."
